descriptor: A virtual STEM lab that finds the wrong idea behind every mistake, then builds the experiment that breaks it.

belief.title: Why heavier objects fall together
belief.detail: Ano spotted the air resistance bias

belief.title: Mass doesn't vanish
belief.detail: Gas can't escape a sealed bag

lowerBand.heading: Learn why your intuition tripped.
lowerBand.body: Guess what will happen. Run it. Ano shows you exactly where your thinking broke.

chip.title: How it works
chip.subtitle: Predict, run, see where it broke

lowerBand.explore: Explore {count} experiments in chemistry and robotics

hero.setup: Two balls, same size. The steel one is three times heavier than the glass one. Make your call, then drop them.
hero.wrong: Whoa, did you see that? They hit the floor together. Weight doesn't change how fast things fall, when air barely matters.
hero.correctLine: Nailed it! Weight doesn't change how fast things fall. Most people guess wrong here.

steps.title: Predict
steps.body: Every experiment starts with your guess. You make the call before you press Run, so your idea is on the record.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: Guess wrong and Ano replays your build through the mistaken ideas students often hold, until one of them predicts exactly what you did.

steps.title: Break
steps.body: Ano picks the one small change where that idea and reality disagree the most. You run it, and the idea cracks.

steps.title: Rebuild
steps.body: Fix the build, run it again, keep the idea that survived.

labs.title: Two labs, one rule
labs.body: Your prediction goes on the record first. The simulator is the judge.

meetAno.title: Meet Ano
meetAno.body: Your lab partner. Ano never says you were silly, only that reality had other plans. Then it finds the idea behind your guess.

lines.happy: Hey, I'm Ano. Want to break some science?
lines.curious: Nice. What do you think will happen?
lines.thinking: Hmm. Let's look at the one part that matters.
lines.surprised: Whoa, did you see that? Let's figure out why.
lines.celebrating: Nailed it! That's exactly how a scientist thinks.

beliefs.title: The belief wall
beliefs.body: Ideas students bring to the lab. Each one has an experiment built to test it.

footer.line: A virtual STEM lab for curious students. Progress stays on this device.

captions.landing: Two thuds, at the same moment
